description: This file contains the source code for the 'Installer' class within the OpenCart admin marketplace module. It handles operations such as listing, uploading, installing, and uninstalling marketplace extensions, managing uploaded files, and generating views with data including pagination, extension details, and action links.

classes.name: Installer
classes.description: The Installer class extends the system Controller and manages the marketplace extension installation process, including listing available extensions, handling uploads, and actions like install, uninstall, and delete.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main installer page with breadcrumbs, extension list, and upload options.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Displays a list of installed extensions with sorting and pagination controls.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of marketplace extensions based on filtering, sorting, and pagination parameters, generating the view with extension data.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles uploading of a marketplace extension package, validation, and extraction,

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Returns a string listing extensions, used internally in listing operations.

methods.name: upload
methods.description: Handles the uploading process of extension files, including validation, reading install.json, and checking for existing files.
